Name: Singleplayer sleep
Author: MindMeltMax
TagLine: Allows players to sleep and regain health/stamina in singleplayer, like they would in multiplayer
Description:
**Description :**
Gives you the abillity to restore stamina and health while laying in bed, just like in multiplayer.
Just hop into bed or onto a chair.

**Compatible with 1.5**

**Installation :**
1. Install [Smapi](http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI)
2. Unzip file and place in mod folder
3. Good Night!

**Update 1.2.0 :**
The Mod is now updated to allow for regen while sitting.
This should have come out right after the 1.5 update but my motivation was lower than my self-esteem

[[Source Code]](https://github.com/MindMeltMax/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/main/SP%20Regen)
